title: Seed the standby store and ship replication batches while serve runs
goal: A running main keeps its named standby's coordinator-standby.sqlite current, so a move starts from the main's latest state
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; real coordinator state, keys and device evidence remain private.
acceptance: A command or serve loop seeds a base's standby store from a signed snapshot of the running main, and serve ships each committed batch over /kaji/replicate to the named standby (tests across both bases): `nerv kaji standby BASE-ID` seeds a base without a standby store over `/kaji/standby/seed`; serve's shipper captures committed rows by trigger and sends one batch at a time, applied once and in order; an unreachable standby shows lag; a standby behind the kept log or without its store is seeded again; `kaji drain` ships the final batch before it fences (test/coordinator-shipping.test.ts, two bases over real KajiLinks)

A fixture shows an effect the old main ran before a partition is known to the promoted main: in test/coordinator-partition.test.ts the remote request X sent and its Telegram offset reach B before the partition; B promotes with nothing quarantined or sent again and resumes from the shipped offset
Owner agreed 2026-11-24 to add this step to the adopted plan, before F-016-T09
validation: Directed regressions across two bases; final required CI
escalation: Found by F-016-T08 on 2026-11-24; adds a step to the adopted plan: the owner agrees scope and order (before F-016-T09) first
Never let two coordinators act, or copy context as authority, to make progress

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 from F-016-T16 to F-016-T19 (1–1.5 h each stated): seeding command, shipping loop, standby apply wiring and fixtures. Not a measurement; uncertain until the owner sets the scope. 2026-11-24: implemented in PR #725; actual stated 3.5 h (capture triggers, seed endpoint and swap, shipper, drain flush, status, fixtures across two bases and the mesh).
